## About
Professional Automotive Repair started out as a specialty shop servicing only Volvo. It was founded by a former technical instructor for the Volvo factory, and Volvo still predominates in our car count. Today we also work on American and import cars, from Ford and GMC to BMW, Toyota, Honda and Subaru.
Mark Kennedy owns the shop now. He spotted it while driving down Lower Roswell Road, met the team, and saw their commitment to customer service, technical knowledge and quality. Our goal is simple: the best possible technical service and customer service at a fair price.
We focus on the repairs your car actually needs. One reviewer came to us on a neighbor's advice, and another found that a suspected bad wheel bearing was just worn tires.

## Services
- Brake repair: Brake inspections, pad and rotor replacement, and full brake system repairs. Come in if you notice squeaking, vibration or longer stopping distances.
- Engine diagnostics and check engine light repair: Computer diagnostics, including Volvo VIDA, to find engine performance problems and warning light codes before anything gets replaced.
- Transmission service and repair: Fluid service through major repairs for automatic and manual vehicles.
- Suspension and steering: If your car feels unstable, pulls to one side or rides rough, we repair shocks, struts, steering parts and alignment issues.
- A/C and cooling system repair: Air conditioning and cooling system service for Georgia summers, including refrigerant leaks, compressor problems and overheating.
- Timing belt replacement: Scheduled timing belt replacement to help protect your engine.
- Tires, balancing and alignments: Tire replacement, balancing and four-wheel alignments.
- Oil changes and tune-ups: Routine services like oil changes and tune-ups.

## FAQ
Q: My car is still under factory warranty. Do I have to go to the dealer?
A: No. We can do the routine services needed to keep your factory warranty, reset your check engine light and stamp your service records.

Q: Do you warranty engine repairs?
A: Yes. Engine repairs come with a 12-month/12,000-mile warranty on both parts and labor.

Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Volvo and also service a wide range of domestic and import makes, including Ford, GMC, BMW, Mercedes, Lexus, Toyota, Honda, Dodge, Acura and Subaru.

Q: Can I drop off or pick up my car after hours?
A: Yes, we offer after hours drop off and pick up.
